def outer():
 value = None
 def read(): return value
 def forget():
  nonlocal value
  del value
 return read, forget
read, forget = outer()
assert read() is None
forget()

except NameError: return 'deleted'

def produce(value):
 def read(): return value
 yield read
 del value
 yield read
g = produce(None)
read = next(g)
assert read() is None
assert next(g) is read
try: read()
except NameError: return 'deleted'
